We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst (Business Intelligence) to join our National Security Innovation Network (NSIN) project and will have the opportunity to serve their country by embedding with key decision makers at the top levels of the U.S. Government. As the Senior Data Analyst, you will work closely with the NSIN Data Cell Lead. This role will join a team already recognized for its standout business analytics. The Senior Data Analyst will be responsible for the success of internal business operations and the decisions made to meet Government goals, all to drive for greater efficiency and accuracy of executing the mission. This role demands a blend of strategic vision, technical expertise, and managerial acuity to drive the success of complex data driven initiatives supporting government operations. Utilize NSIN's data and information about innovation in the US for use in analyzing trends and patterns around technology investments.

Mine data for the purposes of experimenting with predictive model prototypes.

Overview
Job Summary
Tuvli, an Akima company, is hiring for a Data Analyst IV to support our DoS client located in Washington, DC.
The Data Analyst evaluates a range of Monitor and Combat Trafficking in Persons' (J/TIP) data sources and uses data analytics and data visualization techniques to help the J/TIP office to better explain the complex issue of human trafficking and the impacts of the office's anti-trafficking work to the public and other stakeholders. This position is part of the Resource Management and Planning (RMP ) section and under direction of the Deputy Senior Coordinator, or designee. The incumbent will work on data analytic projects and data sets across all components of the TIP Office.
Responsibilities
Job Responsibilities:
Collects, evaluates, and standardizes data relevant to human trafficking policies and programs.
Uses data analytics and data visualization software and tools to develop a variety of visually appealing and easy to interpret products to clearly communicate complex data sets and J/TIP priorities to the public, Department stakeholders, and others.
Develops informational products such as charts, diagrams, maps, and graphics for senior management and other staff.
Analyzes primary and secondary source data and uses data visualization techniques to showcase human trafficking patterns and trends. This includes evaluating, monitoring, and updating data for quality, relevance, and accuracy.

Senior CX Data Analyst
The IIG Client Experience Analytics team is hiring a Senior Client Experience Data Analyst. The team works with cross discipline teams to evaluate, monitor, and improve the client experience. This role will be a strategic partner in the Institutional division's path to toward personalized digital experiences and spearheading an omni-channel client experience. The top skill categories to be successful in this role include: 
 Conceptual thinking to understand and answer ambiguous questions
 Effective communication and consultative skills to guide decisions based on insights
 Technical expertise to tactically execute analyses, modeling, and experimentation
Core Responsibilities
1. Engages with internal partners to understand business strategy, questions and goals. Brings structure to business requests, translates requirements into an analytical project approach, and leads projects through completion. Delegates tasks and provides tactical and strategic guidance to peers.
2. Acquires and compiles structured and unstructured data and verifies its quality, accuracy and reasonableness.
3. Performs analyses of historical data to surface trends and insights using advanced analytical methods. Validates analytical techniques employed by other analysts.
4. Prepares and delivers visualizations and internal presentations that translate analytic insights into tangible, actionable solutions for business partners to implement.
5. Develops, owns and manages recurring analytic or reporting processes.
6. Mentors, coaches, trains, and develops junior data analysts. Proactively expands knowledge of business and analytics and shares with team members. Shares and documents best practices.
7. Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
Minimum of five years related work experience.
Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience.
